name: unshittify
description: A collection of plugins that remove the annoyances of Claude Code.

plugins.name: local
plugins.description: Manage the project-local Claude Code settings (.claude/settings.local.json) that /config and the settings UI do not show per project.

plugins.name: racket
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for work in Racket: classes, contracts, macros, concurrency, GUI, drawing, tests, packages, and more.

plugins.name: global
plugins.description: Inspect and manage the global Claude Code settings of the user (~/.claude/settings.json).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Tools that write Claude Code plugins: skills and agents.

plugins.name: communication
plugins.description: Write and review prose in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100), and format markdown tables. The simplified-technical-english skill holds the condensed STE rules. The review-prose skill and the prose-reviewer agent check prose against STE and the house style of this project (the checklist and its curated examples, plus BadProseExamples.org at the root of the repository when that file is present). The markdown-tables skill aligns the columns of a table.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: General software-development tools that are not specific to one language.

plugins.name: cxx
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for C++ development: a build and a run with sanitizers, a structural query of the code with clang-query, the C++ editing idioms of this project, and more.
